findings.finding_note: PurchaseData is a Firestore-backed purchase and entitlement model with product unlock booleans and purchase counters including disableAdsUnlockedBool, bundle unlock flags, gemPurchaseCount1..6, holidayBundlesBought, managerPackPurchasedBool, and lastMinerPassOwned. It is exposed as PlayerSaveData.purchaseData, completing the cloud composite model alongside saveData and claimableItems.

note: Human-entered observations only. This command does not open external files and does not validate semantic correctness.
